developmentFailureEvidence.detail: The first focused P37 run failed in actions/setup-node before project code executed because npm cache discovery requires a root lockfile. The workflow was aligned to the repository's existing npm install --ignore-scripts strategy and reran green. This was neither a code/test failure nor a runner-allocation failure.

safetyInvariants: the Connections Center is not a credential vault and never persists provider passwords, OAuth tokens, API keys or MCP credentials into project/checkpoint state
local provider inspection makes no remote account calls; explicit live verification remains bounded and read-only
provider login/setup commands and setup URLs come only from extension-side allowlisted definitions, never caller-supplied webview strings
configured or installed MCP metadata is not treated as verified current-session connectivity
P36 launcher-bound host-session evidence remains authoritative for active MCP connection truth
no-login MCP readiness does not imply a connected state
connection verification never grants deployment, database, DNS, Git, destructive or production mutation approval
third-party creative skill selection remains subject to Dockyard trust/readiness/fulfillment boundaries
design references are used for original synthesis rather than reference-site cloning
